text.arabic_uthmani: وَيَسْتَجِيبُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ وَيَزِيدُهُم مِّن فَضْلِهِۦ ۚ وَٱلْكَٰفِرُونَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌۭ شَدِيدٌۭ

words.gloss_range: opening conjunction that resumes prior discourse and launches the response clause without strict causal force
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) makes the ayah enter as continuation: response is joined to the previous divine-action movement rather than introduced as an isolated reward claim. The repeated conjunctions also segment the verse into linked beats: response, faith and work, increase, and final contrast.

topics.headline: opening continuation into response
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices response as continuation of the previous divine-action sequence, not a detached reward claim.
topics.reason: The opening conjunction launches the first clause and lacks explicit causal force.

topics.headline: repeated conjunction cadence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears linked but distinct beats across response, faith and work, increase, and contrast.
topics.reason: The repeated conjunctions are visible at local clause boundaries.

words.gloss_range: ongoing Form X response, syntactically open between divine answering and human responsiveness before divine increase is clarified
words.root_gloss_range: answering, responding, and crossing or traversing as image pressure; local Form X selects responsive relation, not literal crossing
words.prose: {{ar:يَسْتَجِيبُ}} ({{tr:yastajību}}) keeps response in motion before the group is fully defined. Its singular imperfect, missing overt complement, and post-verbal relative head let divine answering and human responsiveness resonate together; the later increase clause clarifies divine agency without erasing that opening reciprocity. The {{ar:ج و ب}} ({{tr:j-w-b}}) field adds crossing-into-answer pressure, narrowed here to relational image rather than literal movement, and the response thread recalls prayer-answering (2:186) alongside same-surah response settings (42:16, 42:38, 42:47).

topics.headline: controlled response ambiguity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices divine answering and human responsiveness resonating before the verse settles into divine increase.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence preserve ambiguity around singular agreement, absent complement, and the post-verbal relative head.

topics.headline: Form X answering relation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels response as an entered, ongoing relation; the crossing image remains relational pressure, not literal spatial sense.
topics.reason: The local Form X response relation is licensed; broader crossing remains image pressure because no spatial construction appears.

topics.headline: response thread and prayer echo
topics.reader_payoff: The reader connects the opening response to a call-answer and pardon-to-increase movement, including prayer-answering (2:186) and same-surah response settings (42:16, 42:38, 42:47).
topics.reason: The rows provide concrete recurrence anchors for the local response verb.

topics.headline: response before group definition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader meets the act of response before the group definition, so relation is foregrounded before participants are unpacked.
topics.reason: Word order places the response verb before the relative group, and the sound row reinforces the delay.

words.gloss_range: plural relative head defining the beneficiary group through faith and work while carrying the opening parse tension
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلَّذِينَ}} ({{tr:alladhīna}}) is the hinge after the response verb: it can be heard as the plural group responding or as the group answered under an implicit divine subject. As the relative clause unfolds, it defines the beneficiaries by completed faith and work, lets the group definition sound collective through the plural cadence, and then is resumed by the plural suffix in the increase clause.

topics.headline: relative head as response hinge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the group name arrives in a position that sustains the response-cycle ambiguity.
topics.reason: The relative head can function in the opening ambiguity rather than forcing one parse.

topics.headline: group defined by predicates
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees beneficiaries defined by faith and restorative action, not lineage or a bare label.
topics.reason: The relative construction is syntactically forced, and the later plural suffix resumes the same group.

topics.headline: collective plural cadence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the group definition as collective before singular divine verbs resume around it.
topics.reason: The cadence row follows the local sequence into plural perfect verbs.

words.gloss_range: completed plural secure trust as the first defining predicate of the beneficiary group
words.root_gloss_range: security, trust, belief, and entrusting; local Form IV perfect selects committed faith as secure trust
words.prose: {{ar:ءَامَنُوا۟}} ({{tr:āmanū}}) gives the group its first completed qualifier: secure trust is already in place before work and increase are named. The {{ar:أ م ن}} ({{tr:ʾ-m-n}}) field makes faith more than opinion, setting entrusted security against the later coverer class and joining the familiar faith-and-work formula to response and bounty, with the formulaic horizon of faith and work (103:3) and a matching plural ending that audibly binds it to the following work verb.

topics.headline: completed trust predicate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices faith as the first established predicate defining the group before deeds and increase follow.
topics.reason: The perfect plural is tied to the relative head and precedes coordinated work.

topics.headline: secure trust against covering
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears belief as secure entrusted trust, sharpening the contrast with covering denial and recalling security resonance (6:82).
topics.reason: The root and Form IV rows cohere with the local faith predicate.

topics.headline: faith-and-work formula with surplus
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes a familiar faith-and-work pattern specialized here by response and increase from bounty, with echoes such as 103:3.
topics.reason: The local sequence contains the formula named by the recurrence rows.

topics.headline: shared plural ending with work
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears faith and work bound as a pair through matching plural endings.
topics.reason: The sound row is tied to adjacent matched perfect plural verbs.

words.gloss_range: coordinating conjunction joining faith and work as distinct predicates under one relative head
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) keeps the second predicate inside the same relative definition. Faith and work are coordinated without collapsing into one term, so action accompanies trust while retaining its own grammatical slot.

topics.headline: coordination of faith and work
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices faith and work paired under one group definition while remaining two distinct predicates.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the following verb as coordinated with the faith verb.

topics.headline: minor cadence reset
topics.reason: The row adds no separate payoff beyond coordination.

words.gloss_range: completed plural work, transitive and morally narrowed by its direct object
words.root_gloss_range: doing, making, performing, and producing deeds; local Form I perfect selects enacted work with evaluable output
words.prose: {{ar:عَمِلُوا۟}} ({{tr:ʿamilū}}) turns secure trust outward into enacted work. The perfect plural keeps the action inside the group definition, and the direct object immediately narrows the work into morally shaped, restorative output rather than generic activity. This faith-work formula echoes the compact pairing (103:3) while closing the group profile before the increase clause.

topics.headline: completed enacted work
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees work as an enacted completed predicate belonging to the same plural group.
topics.reason: The perfect plural is coordinated with faith and tied to the relative group.

topics.headline: work narrowed by its object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices work receiving moral shape from its object, so action is evaluable output rather than bare activity.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence forces the direct-object relation.

topics.headline: faith-work formula before increase
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes the faith-work formula closing the group profile before increase, including formulaic echo (103:3).
topics.reason: Concrete formula and recurrence rows survive in the local faith-work construction.

topics.headline: matched ending already carried
topics.reason: The row repeats the pairing payoff already preserved by the formula topic.

words.gloss_range: definite plural substantive for the known class of restorative sound deeds
words.root_gloss_range: soundness, repair, rightness, and fitness; local plural substantive selects restorative righteous deeds
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ}} ({{tr:al-ṣāliḥāti}}) is the object that makes the work specific. Its definite plural active-participle form names a known class of restorative sound acts, so the group profile closes on repair before the verse turns to increase from bounty. The righteous-deeds promise field is also being shifted toward response and surplus, with the promise formula (2:25) and same-surah recurrence around 42:22, 42:23, and 42:40 in view.

topics.headline: definite object category
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices work narrowed to a recognizable class of sound deeds, not vague goodness.
topics.reason: The word is the direct object and its definite plural participial form supports a known deed category.

topics.headline: restorative repair field
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears righteousness as restoration and soundness, preparing contrast with covering refusal.
topics.reason: The root field is licensed by the substantive deed object.

topics.headline: promise formula before bounty
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes the righteous-deeds promise field, including the shifted promise formula (2:25) and recurrence around 42:22, 42:23, and 42:40.
topics.reason: The rows name concrete formula and same-surah anchors.

topics.headline: minor article assimilation sound
topics.reason: The sound observation adds no separate payoff after the object-category topic.

words.gloss_range: coordinating bridge from group definition to increase without explicit consequence force
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) moves from the completed group description to divine increase. Because the connector is coordination rather than explicit consequence, the increase follows the faithful-working profile without sounding mechanically earned.

topics.headline: non-causal bridge to increase
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices increase coordinated after the profile but not presented as a strict wage formula.
topics.reason: The increase clause is coordinated after the relative-clause description without a causal particle.

topics.headline: minor launch sound
topics.reason: The row adds only an acoustic note to the retained bridge topic.

words.gloss_range: ongoing divine increase directed at the defined believers, open in amount and sourced from bounty
words.root_gloss_range: increase, addition, surplus, and growth beyond a baseline; local transitive imperfect leaves measure open
words.prose: {{ar:يَزِيدُهُم}} ({{tr:yazīduhum}}) clarifies divine agency after the opening ambiguity. The singular imperfect resumes divine action, the attached plural object makes the defined believers inseparable from the increase, and the unspecified measure leaves the increase open as surplus sourced from bounty. This central verb balances the opening response and final nominal penalty, while the increase-from-bounty wording echoes the recompense-plus-extra phrase (35:30).

topics.headline: divine agency with attached object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ambiguity tightening into divine action directed at the defined believers.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the suffix as direct object and the verb as coordinated under divine agency.

topics.headline: open-ended increase from bounty
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels increase as surplus beyond a baseline, open in quantity and quality, and carried toward the bounty-source phrase.
topics.reason: The local transitive imperfect has a plural object and source phrase while amount and domain are not overt.

topics.headline: surplus formula echo
topics.reader_payoff: The reader connects increase-from-bounty wording with the recompense-plus-extra pattern, including the close phrase echo (35:30).
topics.reason: The concrete echo rows match the local increase and bounty-source pattern.

topics.headline: central pivot from profile to source
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees this verb as the middle turn from defined identity to source of surplus before final contrast.
topics.reason: The word stands between the relative profile and source phrase, before the nominal penalty contrast.

words.gloss_range: source or partitive-source preposition governing the bounty phrase
words.prose: {{ar:مِّن}} ({{tr:min}}) makes the increase come from a source-domain. Bounty is not simply the object increased; it is the source or partitive source from which increase is given, binding the beneficiaries directly to the following bounty phrase.

topics.headline: source and partitive source
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices increase located in a source of bounty, with partitive openness still available.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence forces the following bounty phrase as governed complement.

topics.headline: beneficiary-to-source bridge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the beneficiaries carried directly into the bounty-source phrase.
topics.reason: The immediate sequence after the increase verb supports the bridge; sound rows reinforce liaison.

words.gloss_range: divine bounty as the governed source-domain of increase, carrying surplus and favor beyond equivalence
words.root_gloss_range: excess, surplus, excellence, favor, and bounty; local genitive verbal noun names the divine source of increase
words.prose: {{ar:فَضْلِهِۦ}} ({{tr:faḍlihi}}) closes the believer-benefit beat by naming the source as divine bounty. Genitive government and the possessive suffix keep increase anchored in God, while the {{ar:ف ض ل}} ({{tr:f-ḍ-l}}) field gives the source the feel of surplus, excellence, and favor beyond strict equivalence. That surplus logic also recalls the full-wage-plus-bounty pattern (4:173) and the same-surah bounty return (42:22).

topics.headline: governed divine source
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices bounty as the grammatical source of increase and specifically divine through the suffix.
topics.reason: The word is governed by the preceding preposition and carries the possessive suffix.

topics.headline: surplus excellence and favor
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels increase as favor and surplus, not simple equivalent payment for deeds.
topics.reason: The local verbal noun in a source phrase licenses bounty and surplus field.

topics.headline: bounty formula echo
topics.reader_payoff: The reader connects source grammar, surplus semantics, and formulaic recurrence, including full-wage-plus-bounty logic (4:173) and same-surah bounty return (42:22).
topics.reason: The rows provide concrete formula and same-surah anchors for the local bounty source slot.

words.gloss_range: contrastive conjunction opening the final nominal liability clause
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) turns the verse from bounty to liability. It remains a conjunction on the surface while functioning contrastively through context, opening a nominal clause that reverses the movement from response and increase. Its short beat also gives an audible cut into the severe closing frame.

topics.headline: contrastive nominal opening
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the final clause as a contrastive turn without needing an explicit English-style "but".
topics.reason: The following material is identified as a contrastive nominal clause.

topics.headline: audible turn into closure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the short connector pivot into the severe closing frame.
topics.reason: The repeated conjunction frame and severe closure make this local sound-and-structure row coherent.

words.gloss_range: definite plural active participle naming the contrastive coverer class as topic of liability
words.root_gloss_range: covering, concealing, denial, rejection, and ingratitude; local active participle selects the contrastive class of coverers or deniers
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْكَٰفِرُونَ}} ({{tr:al-kāfirūna}}) names the opposing class and places it as topic before the liability phrase. The active participle keeps covering-denial as an identifying posture, and the nominal clause freezes the contrast: believers move through response and increase, while this class is framed by assigned punishment. The denial-warning thread includes severe punishment after denial (14:7) and later same-surah intensification (42:48), and the harder sound of the contrastive topic sharpens the pivot from bounty to punishment.

topics.headline: fronted coverer topic
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the coverer class made the topic before punishment is named, so liability is framed around them.
topics.reason: The definite nominative active participle heads the contrastive nominal liability clause.

topics.headline: covering denial against trust
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears disbelief as covering-denial set against secure trust and restorative repair.
topics.reason: The root and active-participle rows cohere with the local contrast against believers and final punishment.

topics.headline: denial and severe punishment thread
topics.reader_payoff: The reader connects the coverer class to warning recurrence, including severe punishment after denial (14:7) and same-surah intensification (42:48).
topics.reason: The rows name concrete recurrence anchors and the local clause realizes the coverer-punishment pairing.

topics.headline: hard pivot sound
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the contrastive topic enter with a sharper acoustic edge as the verse turns from bounty to punishment.
topics.reason: The sound observation is tied to the contrastive pivot word.

words.gloss_range: prepositional lām assigning liability before the punishment noun is named
words.prose: {{ar:لَ}} ({{tr:la}}) is the assigning preposition inside the fronted liability phrase. With the plural pronoun, it fixes the outcome against the coverers before the punishment noun appears.

topics.headline: fronted liability lām
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices assignment to the group fronted before the punishment itself is named.
topics.reason: The preposition governs the pronoun, and the local punishment noun turns allocation into liability rather than benefit.

words.gloss_range: plural resumptive pronoun governed by lām and pointing back to the coverer topic
words.prose: {{ar:هُمْ}} ({{tr:hum}}) repeats the coverer group inside the predicate rather than introducing a new referent. The resumptive pronoun creates left-dislocation emphasis: the class is named, then the reader passes through their own pronoun before reaching punishment. Its plural shape also mirrors the beneficiary suffix in the increase verb, setting identical pronominal form under opposite outcomes.

topics.headline: resumptive pronoun emphasis
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the punished group named and then resumed, tightening liability around that class.
topics.reason: The pronoun is governed by the preposition and resumes the coverer topic.

topics.headline: same pronoun shape under opposite outcomes
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the same plural pronoun shape under opposite outcomes: believers receive increase and coverers receive liability.
topics.reason: The local suffix on increase and the pronoun in liability share plural value under opposite outcomes.

words.gloss_range: indefinite punishment noun assigned as a standing condition and hardened by its adjective
words.root_gloss_range: punitive suffering and chastisement, with sweet or fresh-water edges not selected locally
words.prose: {{ar:عَذَابٌ}} ({{tr:ʿadhābun}}) supplies the penalty after liability has already been fixed. Its indefiniteness leaves the punishment open in extent, while the abstract noun and verbless clause make it a standing assigned condition. Agreement, adjacency, and paired cadence bind the noun to severity, and the formula recalls the allocation-punishment frame (2:7) plus the same severe-punishment phrase from 42:16. The older sweet/fresh-water edge in {{ar:ع ذ ب}} ({{tr:ʿ-dh-b}}) is not the local sense; the liability phrase and final adjective force punitive suffering.

topics.headline: standing punishment condition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices punishment as an assigned condition in a verbless clause, not merely a narrated future event.
topics.reason: The noun sits inside the nominal liability clause and its abstract form supports condition-like presentation.

topics.headline: indefinite punishment hardened by severity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels punishment as unspecified in extent but tightly bound to severity by agreement, adjacency, and cadence.
topics.reason: The noun is indefinite nominative and modified by the following agreeing adjective.

topics.headline: sweet-water edge blocked locally
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the root-family contrast only as sharpened exclusion: the phrase selects punitive suffering while severity blocks the sweet or fresh-water edge.
topics.reason: Broader root-family awareness survives only as contrast because local liability and adjective evidence force punishment.

topics.headline: punishment formula recurrence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader connects this phrase to warning recurrence, including the allocation-punishment formula (2:7) and same severe-punishment formula from 42:16.
topics.reason: The rows name concrete anchors and the local phrase repeats severe-punishment wording.

words.gloss_range: indefinite qualitative adjective locking severity into punishment and closing the ayah
words.root_gloss_range: tightness, firmness, strength, binding, and severity; local adjective selects constrictive intensity
words.prose: {{ar:شَدِيدٌ}} ({{tr:shadīdun}}) is the ayah's final quality word. It agrees with the punishment noun, making severity internal to the punishment, and the {{ar:ش د د}} ({{tr:sh-d-d}}) field makes that severity feel firm, tight, and constrictive. The closing severity recalls punishment after denial (14:7) and the repeated same-surah formula (42:16), while the dental pressure and paired tanwīn cadence seal punishment and severity together against the earlier open surplus of bounty.

topics.headline: agreement as final modifier
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices severity as the internal final quality of punishment, not a separate verdict added afterward.
topics.reason: The word is an agreeing postposed qualitative adjective, not a comparative.

topics.headline: tight severity field
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels punishment as constrictive severity, drawing on tightness and strength rather than vague negativity.
topics.reason: The root-field rows cohere with the local adjective modifying punishment.

topics.headline: severe warning echo
topics.reader_payoff: The reader connects closing severity to denial-and-punishment warnings, including severe punishment after denial (14:7) and repeated same-surah formula (42:16).
topics.reason: The rows provide concrete recurrence anchors for the final severe adjective.

topics.headline: final cadence seal
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the ayah close with a firm cadence binding punishment and severity.
topics.reason: The word is final in the ayah and the sound rows are tied to the punishment phrase.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The initial yastajibu and the following alladhina amanu permit a response relation whose agency is not fully settled by the focus alone.
baseline_models.mechanism: A returned word, request, or prayer meets a party characterized by settled trust. The focus therefore establishes responsive relation before context decides whether God answers the believers, the believers answer God, or both directions remain active.

activation_trace.role: Return of speech, question, or prayer supplies the literal response relation while leaving its grammatical direction open.
Settled security and trust characterize the human party as receptive rather than merely labeled.

changed_reading.before: God answers a fixed class called believers.
changed_reading.after: The ayah first presents a live response relation with trusting people; the precise direction of response remains a productive focus-level ambiguity.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Amilu al-salihat, yaziduhum, and min fadlihi form an action-repair-growth sequence.
baseline_models.mechanism: Intentional action that opposes corruption and fits its need becomes the substrate for growth beyond sufficiency. Fadl is both what remains beyond requirement and a non-obligatory gift, so the increase exceeds simple wage equivalence.

activation_trace.role: Purposive action supplies the worked human input to the mechanism.
Repair against corruption gives the actions their restorative function.
Fitness and suitability sharpen righteous action as action matched to what a situation needs.
Growth entering upon something turns recompense into an enlarging process.
A gift not owed makes the added yield gracious excess rather than strict payment.

changed_reading.before: Good deeds receive an additional reward.
changed_reading.after: Purposeful, fitting repair is met by a growth process whose yield exceeds contractual equivalence.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The closing contrast joins kafirun to adhab shadid opposite the response-and-increase sequence.
baseline_models.mechanism: Covering a benefit prevents it from becoming acknowledged response, while punishment supplies painful prevention and shadid binds that condition tightly. The contrast is functional: receptive action opens into surplus; covering closes into constraint.

activation_trace.role: Covering a received benefit supplies the negative counterpart to receiving increase from bounty.
Pain and penalty supply the explicit consequence.
Tight binding and fastening render the consequence difficult to loosen or escape.

changed_reading.before: Disbelievers receive severe punishment as a separate doctrinal clause.
changed_reading.after: The clause closes the mechanism: covering the gift and response relation leads from expansive surplus into tightly bound painful constraint.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah conjugates the same response root with believers explicitly responding to their Lord and then commands that response. These forms reactivate the focus syntax so that the believers can be heard as the postverbal subject of yastajibu, while the adjacent divine increase keeps God's answering action live. The result is a reciprocal call-response circuit.

activation_trace.role: The focus response verb is the shared anchor whose subject direction is being revised.
Believers explicitly return their Lord's call, supplying an unambiguous human-to-divine response direction.
The imperative to respond to the Lord confirms human response as a governing surah-level use.

structural_cues: In 42:26 the singular verb precedes alladhina amanu, leaving a plural human subject syntactically available.
The same root recurs with explicit human agency at 42:38 and 42:47.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the focus syntax and two explicit human-response uses; I carry that direction back into 42:26 and infer reciprocity from the following divine increase. The live alternative is that God alone is the subject of yastajibu, carried over from 42:25.

changed_reading.before: God answers believers and then increases them.
changed_reading.after: Believers answer their Lord and are answered with increase; the focus can sustain both directions as a reciprocal response relation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding ayah moves through accepting return and erasing bad acts; the focus then moves through response into increase from gift. Together they form a restoration-plus-surplus sequence: the relation is not merely reset to zero but reopened for growth.

activation_trace.role: Acceptance with approval supplies restored reception before the focus response.
Leaving punishment and erasing fault supplies the clearing operation.
Growth shows that clearing fault is followed by positive enlargement.
Unearned gift supplies the excess beyond restored standing.

structural_cues: 42:25 immediately precedes 42:26 and retains the same divine subject across acceptance, pardon, knowledge, response, and increase.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adjacency and the operations acceptance, erasure, growth, and gift; I infer a staged relational sequence rather than four isolated predicates. The alternative is simple coordination without a causal progression.

changed_reading.before: The focus promises reward to already successful believers.
changed_reading.after: The focus completes a repair cycle in which accepted return and erased fault open into response and more-than-restorative growth.

context_deltas.mechanism: Elsewhere the same increase is applied to a cultivated harvest and to an acquired good whose goodness is itself enlarged, while the repeated believer-work formula culminates in great fadl. Increase in the focus is therefore multiplication within a planted and practiced moral field, not an unrelated bonus.

activation_trace.role: Sowing and cultivation provide the material model for a yield that can be increased.
The same growth branch acts directly upon the cultivated harvest.
Acquisition that adheres to its doer makes the good an owned substrate rather than an abstract score.
Doing good and the increased goodness name the quality being amplified.
Repeated increase confirms amplification of the acquired good itself.
The repeated believer-work formula ends in a great surplus, tying fadl to the same cultivation sequence.

structural_cues: 42:22 repeats amanu wa-amilu al-salihat and names the outcome al-fadl al-kabir.
42:20 and 42:23 repeat the increase verb with explicit productive substrates.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated formulas and agricultural/acquisitive branch images; I infer that the object cultivated is the quality and reach of the good action. A live alternative is that each occurrence denotes a separately assigned reward.

changed_reading.before: God adds an unspecified amount to the believers' reward.
changed_reading.after: God multiplies the yield and goodness of what responsive people intentionally cultivate and repair.

context_deltas.mechanism: The ayah immediately after the focus denies indiscriminate expansion: apportioned provision is released to a measured limit because unchecked abundance can cross into aggression. The next ayah images release as rain after hope has been cut off, spreading mercy that revives dry growth. Fadl-increase becomes calibrated, timed regeneration rather than maximum quantity.

activation_trace.role: Surplus in the focus is the quantity whose mode of release is revised by the following context.
Expansion, increase, and surplus name the abundance that is explicitly not released without limit.
Apportioned gift makes distribution governed rather than automatic.
Crossing the limit through aggression supplies the harm prevented by unmeasured expansion.
A quantity brought to its proper bound supplies the calibration rule.
Relief of one in distress gives the delayed release a rescuing function.
Hope cut off marks the threshold after which the release arrives.
Rain reviving dry pasture supplies the regenerative effect of measured bounty.

structural_cues: 42:27 and 42:28 immediately follow the focus and form a restraint-then-release pair.
The sequence moves from excess that would provoke transgression to measured descent and reviving spread.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the adjacency, limits, transgression risk, despair, rain, and revival; I infer that wise timing explains how focus increase operates. The alternative is that 42:27 concerns only material provision while 42:26 remains solely eschatological.

changed_reading.before: Increase from bounty means unrestricted abundance.
changed_reading.after: Increase from bounty is a measured regenerative release: limited when excess would corrupt and opened when it can revive.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later portrait of responders turns salihat from an unspecified pious category into a social operating pattern: answer the Lord, establish shared worship, extract judgment through mutual review, circulate provision, and move beyond equivalent retaliation through pardon and reconciliation. These acts make communal relations workable.

activation_trace.role: Purposeful action anchors the later practices back in the focus.
Repair against corruption supplies the common function of the social practices.
Answering the Lord initiates the explicit practice cluster.
Extracting judgment through mutual review supplies a collective decision mechanism.
The outward flow of wealth turns received provision into social circulation.
Forbearing punishment interrupts a merely retaliatory cycle.
Removing estrangement between people specifies reconciliation as a salih act.

structural_cues: 42:37-43 is a coordinated portrait of the same believing group across worship, consultation, spending, defense, pardon, repair, patience, and forgiveness.
42:40 places aslah directly after voluntary pardon and before reward from God.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the coordinated practices and their branch functions; I infer that they are concrete, non-exhaustive instances of amilu al-salihat. The alternative is to treat them as independent virtues with no backward specification of 42:26.

changed_reading.before: Righteous deeds are an undefined stock of private merits.
changed_reading.after: Righteous deeds are responsive practices that repair and govern shared life through worship, deliberation, circulation, proportion, pardon, and reconciliation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah pairs increased good with divine appreciation, asks for patient gratitude amid controlled movement, and finally calls the human kafur after tasted mercy and self-produced harm. Against this network, the focus kafirun are not only deniers of propositions; they function as coverers who fail to let received bounty become acknowledged, responsive action.

activation_trace.role: Gift and beneficence supply what can be either acknowledged or covered.
Covering a benefit supplies the focus polarity opposite responsive reception.
Recognition of benefit links the increase of good to an answering appreciation.
Grateful recognition is the human posture that makes signs effective under constrained conditions.
Merciful tenderness supplies the tasted benefit immediately preceding the kafur diagnosis.
The repeated root after tasted mercy activates ingratitude and covering of benefit within the surah itself.

structural_cues: 42:23 joins increase with the name Shakur.
42:48 narrates tasted mercy, joy, self-caused harm, and then names the human kafur.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the gift-gratitude-covering sequence; I infer that acknowledged bounty should issue in response and action. The live alternative remains the focus inventory's direct branch of doctrinal denial, which this functional reading supplements rather than replaces.

changed_reading.before: The believers and disbelievers are two static identity classes.
changed_reading.after: The contrast also tracks two treatments of gift: responsive trust makes bounty visible in action, while kufr covers the benefit and breaks that circulation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The command to respond is bounded by a coming day with no return and no refuge. This temporal closure explains the severity at the focus ending: response is presently possible, but persistent nonresponse hardens into a condition that cannot be sent back, reversed, or escaped.

activation_trace.role: The imperative makes response a present action demanded before closure.
Return to a prior place supplies the reversal that will no longer be available.
Taking protection in a refuge supplies the escape that will no longer be available.
Painful punishment anchors the temporal closure back in the focus consequence.
Tight fastening renders the eventual condition resistant to reversal.

structural_cues: 42:47 places istajib before a day explicitly lacking both return and refuge.
The focus itself juxtaposes present response with a tightly severe consequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the imperative and the two denied exits; I infer that irreversibility is one mechanism of shadid. The alternative is that severity denotes intensity alone, without a temporal no-return component.

changed_reading.before: Response and punishment are timeless descriptions of two groups.
changed_reading.after: The focus marks an open response interval whose refusal tends toward a tightly irreversible and refuge-less outcome.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's non-dominant j-b-y mapping for focus j-w-b rather than the ordinary response branch. It remains anchored because the focus inventory explicitly supplies that mapping and 42:13 realizes the same mapped branch as selection and drawing near. Downstream prose should present it only as a form-distant activation, never as a replacement lexical meaning for yastajibu.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus j-w-b inventory maps to j-b-y B004, allowing response to pick up a faint image of selective drawing-near.

activation_trace.role: The split-root inventory contributes selection, proximity, and special drawing-near as an exploratory undertone to response.
The surah's realized j-b-y occurrence activates the same mapped image of choosing and bringing near.

changed_reading.before: Response is only the return of a call.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, being answered or answering also marks being drawn near and selected into a responsive relation.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it carries j-w-b's material piercing and opening branches into a communication scene. It remains valid as an image because those branches belong to the focus root, the focus contrasts them with k-f-r covering, and the surah later places hidden communication behind a veil and turns revelation into light. Downstream prose should qualify it as a spatial metaphor, not an etymological definition of divine response.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Focus j-w-b can image a penetrating opening while focus k-f-r images covering.

activation_trace.role: Penetrating cut supplies the force that passes through a closed surface.
An opened gap supplies the resulting space of access.
Covering supplies the opposed closed condition.
Knowledge delivered in concealment supplies the communication that must traverse indirect access.
A screening barrier supplies the communication boundary.
Illumination supplies what becomes available when the communicative opening is effective.

changed_reading.before: Answering is an abstract exchange of speech.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, response pierces a cover and opens an aperture through which hidden address becomes guiding light.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the focus packet's z-y-d to z-w-d split and links it to the surah's closing path and final becoming. It remains anchored in yaziduhum and min fadlihi, with the whole-surah path supplying orientation. Downstream prose should call it a provisioning analogy, not translate yaziduhum as supplying travel stores.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus increase root maps to a branch of carrying provisions for transition, while fadl supplies surplus beyond immediate need.

activation_trace.role: Carried provision for transition recasts increase as capacity for an onward journey.
Surplus beyond present requirement supplies stores that can sustain movement beyond the current stage.
The straight traversable path supplies the route for which increased capacity matters.
Becoming toward an outcome supplies the journey's final orientation.

changed_reading.before: Increase is a larger possession at the destination.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, bounty also provisions responsive people with added capacity to travel the path toward their final becoming.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it sets the sweet-water and abstention branches inside adhab against the surah's reviving rain. It remains anchored in the focus punishment root and its severe binding, while 42:28 supplies a nearby whole-surah material contrast. Downstream prose should retain explicit pain and punishment as primary and offer deprivation of reviving flow only as a secondary image.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus adhab inventory holds sweet water, enforced abstention, and punishment together under a condition intensified by shadid.

activation_trace.role: Sweet, drinkable water supplies the desirable flow whose absence can be felt.
Prevention and weaning supply deprivation from that desirable flow.
Pain and punishment keep the outlier attached to the explicit focus sense.
Tight fastening makes the deprivation enforced rather than incidental.
Life-giving rain supplies the positive material flow contrasted with deprivation.
Revival of dry pasture makes access to the flow visibly regenerative.

changed_reading.before: Severe punishment is only externally inflicted pain.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it also images tightly enforced deprivation from the sweet, reviving flow that bounty releases to responsive life.

strongest_changes: The focus response becomes reciprocal: believers answer their Lord and divine increase answers them.
Increase from fadl becomes cultivated multiplication that exceeds wage equivalence.
The immediately following provision-and-rain sequence revises increase as measured, timed regeneration rather than unrestricted abundance.
Kufr becomes functionally visible as covering received benefit, opposite gratitude that circulates gift through responsive action.
Salih works become concrete social repair through consultation, spending, proportionate redress, pardon, and reconciliation.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah recurrence did not merely confirm reward and punishment. It activated the focus verb's unresolved agency, turned surplus into a calibrated ecological and social process, and made non-dominant mapped roots yield contained images of selection, aperture, journey provision, and withheld reviving flow.
remaining_uncertainties: The syntax of yastajibu still permits a divine subject; the reciprocal model preserves rather than resolves that ambiguity.
The j-b-y and z-w-d activations are form-distant packet mappings and should not be promoted into lexical substitutions.
The packet does not force a single relation between worldly measured provision and the focus increase, which may remain eschatological, transformative, or both.
The sweet-flow punishment image is materially coherent but branch-distant and should remain secondary to explicit pain and penalty.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Faithful response cuts through into sound action and surplus.** Lexical evidence: ج و ب `B001` (piercing/cutting through) and `B003` (responding), ء م ن `B002` (trusting assent), ص ل ح `B001` (soundness), ز ي د `B001` (increase), and ف ض ل `B001`/`B003` (excess/bounty). Structural cue and role: response is immediately coordinated with belief and sound works, then exceeded by divine addition. Abductive move: I infer that genuine response penetrates from assent into action; bounty then goes beyond equivalence. Reading change: **يَسْتَجِيبُ** is an enacted answer whose yield is more than contractual recompense.

2. **Covering blocks the response-channel and leaves a tightly fastened consequence.** Lexical evidence: ك ف ر `B003` (covering/rejecting truth), ع ذ ب `B005` (punishment), and ش د د `B001` (fastening a bond) with `B002` (hard intensity). Structural cue and role: the second clause sharply opposes responsive openness to covering. Abductive move: I infer that rejection closes the channel traversed in the first reading, while severe consequence fixes what refusal attempted to evade. Reading change: the two outcomes arise from opposed response structures.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 42:38 repeats response as the opening of a communal sequence, showing that **يَسْتَجِيبُ** here anticipates worship, consultation, and expenditure rather than stopping at assent.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Response opens a passage through a previously closed condition.** **Lexical evidence:** ج و ب `B003` (answering and responding), with `B004` (opening, hollow, or cleared gap), anchored in يَسْتَجِيبُ. **Structural cue:** 42:25 receives return; 42:28 brings relief after despair; 42:30-31 pair affliction with pardon but deny escape. **Assigned role:** the answer branch supplies reciprocity, while the gap branch models response as an opening unavailable through flight. **Abductive move:** I infer that response clears a viable passage through distress; the spatial image is latent rather than the direct sense of the fixed form. **Reading change:** divine-human response becomes an opened relational channel, not merely a favorable verdict.
2. **Bounty is explicitly surplus beyond the response.** **Lexical evidence:** ز ي د `B001` (increase and growth) and ف ض ل `B001` (excess and remainder), anchored in وَيَزِيدُهُم مِّن فَضْلِهِۦ. **Structural cue:** the increase follows faith, work, and response, while 42:27 immediately limits ordinary provision by measure. **Assigned role:** response meets what is asked or enacted; فضل adds what strict matching does not require. **Abductive move:** I infer two stages from the coordination: answer, then surplus increase. **Reading change:** the ayah preserves grace as a distinct excess rather than folding it into earned recompense.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 42:28's relief after despair was the strongest support for ج و ب `B004` as an opened gap. 42:27 distinguished added فضل from ordinary measured provision, and 42:30's pardon showed that the opening is relief within consequence, not a route of evasion.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak anlatımı, bir şeyi delip geçecek biçimde kesmeyi ortak çekirdek olarak verir; kaya oyma, yer kazma, giysi açıklığı açma ve boynuzun deriyi yararak çıkması bu çekirdeğin farklı gerçekleşmeleridir. Sağlanan dal çerçevesi bu işlem ve sonuç ilişkisini doğru biçimde korur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, nesnede geçişli bir yarma veya kesme işlemiyle sınırlıdır; yer aşma, sözlü karşılık ve yalnızca oluşmuş boşluk bu çekirdeğe girmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım genel delip kesme çekirdeğini, belirli yapılara bağlı giysi, kazma ve boynuz örneklerinden ayırır; bu özel kullanımlar yalın anlamın tamamı sayılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi yarıp öte yanına geçecek biçimde kesmek veya delmek; kaya oyma ve yer kazma bunun sert yüzey ya da zemin üzerindeki özel gerçekleşmeleridir. Giyside açıklık oluşturma ile boynuzun deriyi yararak dışarı çıkması da aynı geçişli yarılma düzenine bağlıdır.

facets.statement: Bir nesneyi, içinde geçişli bir açıklık oluşacak biçimde yarma, delme veya kesme işlemi.
Kayayı oyarak kesme ya da bir yeri kazıp çukurlaştırma, çekirdek işlemin sert yüzey ve zemin üzerindeki özel biçimleridir.
Giyside yaka açıklığı açmak ve boynuzun deriyi delerek çıkması, geçişli yarılmanın somut örnekleridir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak anlatımı delme ile kesmeyi tek bir geçişli işlemde birleştirir; giysi biçme, kaya oyma, kazma ve deriyi yararak çıkma bu işlemin farklı nesnelerdeki görünümleridir.

concept_map.definition: Bir söze, soruya, çağrıya veya isteğe sözle ya da uygun eylemle karşılık vermek. Karşılıklı söz alışverişi bu işlemin iki yönlü biçimi, bir çağrıya uyma veya isteği yerine getirme ise eylemle gerçekleşen biçimidir.

facets.statement: Önceden yöneltilmiş bir söz veya soruya karşı söz üreterek karşılık verme.
Bir çağrıya yönelmek, ona uymak veya isteyenin dileğini yerine getirmek, karşılığın eylemle verilmiş uzantısıdır.
İki tarafın birbirine karşılık vererek konuşması, tek yönlü karşılığın karşılıklı konuşmaya genişlemiş biçimidir.
Yanlış işitmenin yanlış karşılığa yol açtığını anlatan kalıplaşmış söz, çekirdek ilişkinin sonuç bildiren bir örneğidir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar karşılığı sözle verme ile çağrıya veya isteğe eylemle karşılık vermeyi aynı alanda toplar; karşılıklı konuşma iki tarafın art arda karşılık üretmesi olarak sunulur.

concept_map.definition: Yerde, dağda, bulutta veya bir nesnenin ortasında açılmış, genişlemiş ya da boş kalmış alan. Bulutun açılması bu boşluğun oluşma sürecini, ortası oyuk nesne ise kalıcı sonucunu gösterir.

facets.statement: Bir yüzeyde veya iki bölüm arasında açılmış ve genişlemiş boşluk, aralık ya da çukur alan.
Yerdeki çukur alan ile bulut veya dağ arasındaki açıklık, çekirdeğin çevresel gerçekleşmeleridir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak anlatımı kadınların giydiği bir zırh veya giysiyi, kalkanı, kesilmiş bir üstlüğü ve giysiyi üstüne geçirme eylemini açıkça aynı dalda sıralar. Sağlanan çerçeve bu adlandırmaları tek nesneye indirgemeden koruduğu için uygundur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, giysi ve korunma nesnesi adları ile giysiyi üstüne geçirme eylemini kapsar; fiziksel kesme yalnız giysinin biçimini açıklayan arka plandır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın dalda tanıklanan giysi, zırh ve kalkan adlarını temel alır; giysiyi üstüne geçirme eylemi kaynakta verilen türemiş kullanım olarak ayrıca belirtilir.

concept_map.definition: Kadının giydiği zırh veya giysi, kesilmiş bir üstlük ya da savunmada kullanılan kalkan için kullanılan ad. Buna bağlı eylem, bir giysiyi bedene geçirip giymektir.

facets.statement: Kadının bedenine giydiği zırh veya koruyucu nitelikli giysi adı.
Aynı adın elde taşınan savunma aracı olan kalkanı belirtmesi ayrı bir nesne değeridir.
Kesilmiş bir tür üstlüğü belirtmesi, giysi alanındaki özel adlandırmadır.
Bir gömleği veya başka giysiyi bedene geçirip giymek, nesne adından ayrılan eylem kullanımıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar kadın giysisi veya zırhı ile kalkanı ayrı nesne değerleri olarak verir; kesilmiş üstlük anlamı giysi alanını özelleştirir, giysiyi bedene geçirme ise eylem uzantısıdır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Uydurma çerçevesi kaynak sözünün suçlayıcı yorumunu doğru verir, ancak bu anlam genel bir eylem değildir. Yalnızca bir bildiri parçasının kişinin kendisince derlenip uydurulduğunu öne süren belirli soru kalıbında geçerlidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Anlam, belirli suçlayıcı söyleyişe bağlıdır; genel seçme, yaklaştırma veya toplama anlamı sayılamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalnızca verilen soru kalıbını açıklar ve buradan yalın biçime genel bir uydurma anlamı çıkarmaz.

concept_map.definition: Belirli bir soru kalıbında, karşıdakine bir bildiri parçasını kendisinin bir araya getirip uydurmuş olabileceği yolunda yöneltilen suçlamadır. Söz, gerçek bir öneriden çok bildirinin kendisine ait olmadığını yadsıyanların yakıştırmasını aktarır.

facets.statement: Belirli soru kalıbında karşıdakine bir bildiriyi kendisinin derleyip uydurduğunu yakıştırmak.
Bildirinin Yaratıcıdan gelmediğini öne süren suçlayıcı bir söyleyiş olarak kullanılması.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak açıklaması, belirli soru kalıbını kişinin bildiriyi önceden kendisinin derleyip uydurduğu yolundaki suçlayıcı bir yakıştırma olarak yorumlar.

error_profile.loses: Bir araya getirip derleme yönünü açıkça söylemez.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü öne eğilmiş ayakta duruşu, elleri dizlere koymayı, dizler üzerinde yüzüstü kapanmayı ve yere kapanmayı birlikte verir. Toplanma ise bağımsız bir toplama eylemi değil, bedenin bükülüp kendi üzerine çekilmesini açıklayan yön olarak anlaşılmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal bedensel duruş ve kapanmayla sınırlıdır; mal, su veya başka nesneleri toplama anlamına gelmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın duruş ve kapanma anlamlarını korur; bedensel toparlanma açıklamasını nesne toplama anlamına genişletmez.

concept_map.definition: Ayaktayken gövdeyi öne eğip elleri dizlere koymak veya dizler üzerinde yüzüstü yere kapanmaktır. Her iki durumda da beden dik ve açık duruştan bükülmüş, kendi üzerine toplanmış bir duruşa geçer.

facets.statement: Ayakta gövdeyi öne eğmek ve elleri dizlerin üzerine koymak.
Dizler üzerinde yüzüstü kapanmak ya da yere kapanmak.
Bükülme sırasında bedenin kendi üzerine çekilip toparlanması.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu anlatım, öne eğilmiş ayakta duruş ile diz çöküp yüzüstü kapanmayı aynı bedensel bükülme alanında birleştirir ve bu kapanmayı bedenin toparlanmasıyla açıklar.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bu dalda temel olarak bir seyi kesmeyi, ozellikle de kokunden ayirip koparmayi verir. Deve horgucunun kokunden kesilmesi ve igdis edilmis kisinin organlarinin alinmasi bu cekirdegin ozel uygulamalari olarak ayni sinir icinde kalir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Duyusal kesip ayirma cekirdektir; korkak adam ya da ayri kap anlamlari bu dala girmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Hem yalın kesme adi hem de horguc ve igdis etme baglamlari vardir; tanim bunlari tek bir kokten kesme ekseninde ayirir.

concept_map.definition: Bir seyi bulundugu kokten veya taban bagindan keserek ayirma, yok etme ya da bu kesilmis halde bulunma anlamidir.

facets.statement: Temel hareket, nesneyi kokunden veya asil bagindan kesip ayirmaktir.
Horgucun kokunden alinmasi ve igdis etmede organlarin alinmasi bu kesmenin beden uzerindeki ozel kullanimlaridir.
Kesme eyleminin sonucu olarak kesilmis horguclu hayvan veya kesilmis kisi nitelenir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar ortak bicimde kesme anlamini verir ve bunu kokunden koparma sinirina tasir. Horgucun kesilmesi, her sey icin kesip ayirma fiili ve igdis edilmis kisi ornekleri ayni fiziksel ayirma cekirdegini destekler.

concept_gloss.applicability: Genel kesme cekirdegini ve horguc ya da beden organi gibi kokten koparma uygulamalarini birlikte karsilar.

error_profile.preserves: Kok bagindan kesme, ayirma ve kesilmis sonucun hepsini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Eylemin kendisi soz konusu oldugunda kullanilir.

error_profile.preserves: Kesme eylemini ve kokten ayirma sinirini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Horgucu ya da bedensel uzvu alinmis kisi veya hayvan nitelenirken uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Kesme sonucunda ortaya cikan durumu korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dalda cekirdek hareket kesip kokunden ayirmadir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Kuyu dali, kesilme sonucunu degil belirli bir su cukurunu adlandirir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Iki dal da ayrilmislik veya acilmis derinlik tasavvuruyla temas eder.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal bir eylem ve bu eylemin sonucu olan kokten kesilmis durumu anlatir; komsu dal ise kaplanmamis ya da derin bir kuyunun adidir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Aday komsular kesme, kuyu, giysi, kap ve yol alanlarina dagilir; en gerekli ayrim kokten kesme ile kuyu adlandirmasi arasindadir.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه أصل القطع والاستئصال، وقطع السنام، وجب الخصي، وكل ما نصت المصادر على أنه قطع من أصله.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه رجل جبا المهموز بمعنى الجبان، ولا الجبجبة التي نص المفردات على أنها ليست من هذا المعنى.
branches.source_phrase_ar: الجب القطع (maqayis;sihah;mufradat)؛ استئصال السنام من أصله وبعير أجب (ayn;tahdhib)؛ كل شيء قطعته فقد جببته وخصي مجبوب (jamhara)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi dogrudan birini veya toplulugu ustun gelerek asmayi verir; guzellikte baskin cikma bunun belirgin bir kullanimidir. Kesme imgesi burada fiziksel degil, benzeriyle ayni duzeyde olma bagini koparan mecazi ustunluk olarak kalir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal fiziksel kesmeye degil, kisinin veya toplulugun denklerini geride birakan ustunluguna aittir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Topluluğa karsi ustun gelme ve kadinin guzellikle diger kadinlari gecmesi birlikte verilir; tanim bu baglamlari genellestirir ama fiziksel kesmeye tasimaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir kimsenin ya da seyin denklerini ustunlukla geride birakmasi, ozellikle guzellik veya baska bir nitelikle onlari asmasi anlamidir.

facets.statement: Cekirdek anlam, rakip veya denk sayilan kisileri ustun gelerek asmadir.
Kadinin guzelligiyle diger kadinlari geride birakmasi ozel ve sik vurgulanan kullanimdir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar bu dali ustun gelme anlaminda birlestirir. Bazilari bunu guzellikte baskin cikma ornegiyle, bazilari da topluluga karsi galip olma ifadesiyle verir; fiziksel kesme yalniz mecazi aciklama olarak kalir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Topluluk veya denkler uzerinde nitelik, guzellik ya da benzer bir sebeple baskin cikma baglamlarina uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Ustun gelme, denkleri asma ve guzellik ozel kullanimini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kadinlar arasinda guzellik ustunlugu anlatildiginda uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Guzellik sebebiyle ustun gelme ayrintisini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kisinin bir toplulugu asmasi veya yenmesi baglaminda kullanilir.

error_profile.preserves: Topluluga karsi baskin cikma anlamini korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dalda kesme mecazi bir aciklama olup asil anlam ustun gelmedir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komsu dalda asil anlam duyusal olarak kokten kesip ayirmadir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Ikisi de bir esitleme veya baglilik durumunun ortadan kalkmasi fikrine temas eder.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal kisi ya da toplulugu nitelik bakimindan geride birakmayi anlatir; komsu dal gercek kesme eylemini ve kesilmis sonucu anlatir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Aday komsular yenme, baskin cikma ve kendi kokunun kesme dallariyla iliskilidir; yayinlanan ayrim mecazi ustunlugu fiziksel kesmeden ayirir.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه جب القوم أو النساء إذا غلبهم، ولا سيما غلبة المرأة النساء بحسنها وفاقها لهن.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه القطع الحسي نفسه إلا من جهة التشبيه والاستعارة.
branches.source_phrase_ar: جبه إذا غلبه بحسنه أو غيره كأنه قطعه عن مساماته (maqayis)؛ والجب الغلبة (ayn)؛ جبت المرأة النساء إذا غلبتهن من حسنها (jamhara;tahdhib;mufradat)؛ فلان جب القوم إذا غلبهم (sihah)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi giyilen ve bedeni icine alarak saran bir giysiyi verir; zirh adi olarak kullanimi da giyilen koruyucu nesne sinirindadir. Bu dal, mızrak yuvasi veya ev ortasi gibi ic bosluk adlariyla karistirilmamalidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal giyilen, bedeni saran esyaya aittir; soket, kuyu veya genel kap anlamlari ayridir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalin giysi adi ve zirh adi birlikte bulunur; tanim saran giyilebilir nesne sinirini korur.

concept_map.definition: Bedeni icine alip saran giyilebilir nesne, bunun cogulu ve zırh adi olarak kullanilan koruyucu giysi anlamidir.

facets.statement: Temel anlam, bedeni icine alan ve uzerinde tasinan giysidir.
Ayni ad koruyucu bir zırh icin de kullanilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar giyilen nesneyi ortak kabul eder ve onun bedeni sarmasi aciklamasini verir. Ek olarak zırh adi olarak kullanilmasi, giysi cekirdeginin koruyucu bir alt turu gibi belirtilir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Giyilen ana nesne ve zırh adi olarak koruyucu giysi kullanimi icin uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Bedeni icine alma, giyilme ve zırh alt turunu korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Gundelik giyim nesnesi olarak aktarimda kullanilir.

error_profile.preserves: Giyilen ve bedeni saran nesne anlamini korur.
error_profile.loses: Zırh adi olarak kullanimi bu ifade icinde acikca gorunmez.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Koruyucu savas giysisi anlamindaki ozel kullanim icindir.

error_profile.preserves: Koruyucu giyilebilir nesne alt anlamini korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dalda nesne giyilir ve bedeni sarar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komsu dalda bir sey icine giren yuva veya bosluk anlatilir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Ikisi de icine alma ve sarma goruntusuyle temas eder.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal bedene giyilen nesneyi anlatir; komsu dal mızrak ucu, goz, ev veya boynuz gibi yerlerdeki giris boslugunu anlatir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Adaylar giysi, sarma ve ic bosluk alanlarina yakindir; en yararli sinir giysi ile giris yuvasi arasindadir.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الجبة التي تلبس، وجمعها جباب وجبب، وما سمي من الدروع جبة.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه تجاويف الرمح والعين والدار إلا من جهة صورة الدخول والاشتمال.
branches.source_phrase_ar: الجبة معروفة لأنها تشمل الجسم وتجمعه فيها (maqayis)؛ الجباب جمع الجبة التي تلبس (ayn)؛ الجباب التي تلبس (sihah)؛ الجبة التي تلبس والجبة من أسماء الدروع (tahdhib)؛ الجبة التي هي اللباس منه (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi mızrak ucuna giren sap yuvasi, goz cukuru, evin ortasi, hurma tomurcugunun ici ve boynuzdaki yer gibi icine girilen veya icte kalan yerleri birlikte verir. Bu, bagimsiz kuyu ya da giyilen giysi degil, belirli nesnelerdeki giris veya ic bosluk adidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal belirli nesne icindeki yuva ve ic boslukla sinirlidir; kuyu ve giysi dallari ayridir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Cok sayida tamlama ve bir form kullanimi vardir; tanim yalın genel bosluk degil bu baglamlardaki giris yerlerini ayirir.

concept_map.definition: Bir nesnenin baska bir seyin icine girdigi yuva ya da goz, ev, tomurcuk ve boynuz gibi yapilarda icte kalan bolum anlamidir.

facets.statement: Temel ortaklik, bir seyin icine girdigi veya icte kaldigi bosluk ve yuva olmasidir.
Mızrak ucuna sapin girdigi yer en belirgin teknik kullanimdir.
Goz cukuru, evin ortasi, tomurcugun ici ve boynuzdaki yer ayni ic bolum tasavvuruyla kullanilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar mızrak ucu yuvasi etrafinda ortaklasir ve bunu icine girilen yer olarak aciklar. Tek kaynakli ek ornekler goz, ev, hurma tomurcugu ve boynuzdaki ic bolumleri ayni sekle baglar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Mızrak ucu yuvasi ve benzer ic bolumler icin kisa, genel karsiliktir.

error_profile.preserves: Giris yeri, ic bosluk ve baglama gore ic bolum anlamlarini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Silah parcasinda sapin girdigi yer anlatildiginda kullanilir.

error_profile.preserves: Teknik giris yuvasi anlamini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Goz, ev, tomurcuk veya boynuz gibi nesnelerdeki ic kisim aktariminda uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Icte kalan bolum anlamini korur.
error_profile.loses: Mızrak ucuna giren teknik yuva ayrintisi gorunmez.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal nesne icindeki yuva veya ic kisimdir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Kuyu dali yeryuzunde acilmis su cukurunu anlatir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Ikisi de ic bosluk ve derinlik tasavvuruyla temas eder.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal mızrak ucu, goz veya ev gibi bir nesnenin ic bolumunu anlatir; komsu dal bagimsiz bir kuyu adidir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Adaylar oyuk, ic bolum, kuyu ve giysi alanlarina dagilir; en belirgin okur karisikligi ic yuva ile kuyu arasindadir.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه جبة السنان أو الرمح، وحجاج العين، ووسط الدار، وداخل طلعة، وجب القرن، وكل موضع مصور كجوف يدخل فيه شيء.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه البئر المستقلة ولا اللباس، وإن اشتركت في صورة الجوف أو الاشتمال.
branches.source_phrase_ar: الجبة ما دخل فيه ثعلب الرمح من السنان (maqayis)؛ جبة السنان أي مدخله (ayn)؛ الجبة ما دخل فيه الرمح من السنان (sihah)؛ جبة العين حجاجها وجبة الدار وسطها وجب طلعة داخلها وجب القرن الذي فيه المشاشة (tahdhib)؛ به شبه ما دخل فيه الرمح من السنان (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi deri parcalardan yapilan toprak tasima sepetini ve et, parca et veya eritilmis yag konan iskembe turu kabi birlikte verir. Ses veya iri yanlilik anlamlari acikca bu kapsamin disinda tutulmalidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal tasima ya da saklama kabi olan deri veya iskembe nesnesidir; ses ve beden iriligi anlamlari ayridir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Mekanik kapsam yalındır; tanim tamlama baglamina dayanmadan kap ve tasima nesnesi olarak kurulur.

concept_map.definition: Toprak tasimaya yarayan deri sepet ya da et, parca et ve eritilmis yag konan iskembe turu kap anlamidir.

facets.statement: Cekirdek ortaklik, malzeme koyulan ve tasinan deri veya iskembe kaynakli kap olmasidir.
Bir kullanimda toprak tasimak icin deriden yapilmis sepeti anlatir.
Baska kullanimda et, parca et veya eritilmis yag konan iskembe kabi anlatilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar kap anlamini iki somut alanda verir: toprak tasiyan deri sepet ve yiyecek ya da yag konan iskembe kabi. Her iki kullanimda da nesne bir seyi icinde tutup tasimaya yarar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Toprak tasima sepeti ile yiyecek veya yag kabi anlamlarini ortak bir kap cekirdeginde karsilar.

error_profile.preserves: Deri sepet, iskembe kabi ve icinde malzeme bulundurma islevini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Toprak tasimak icin kullanilan deri kap anlatildiginda uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Deri sepet ve toprak tasima islevini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Et, parca et veya yag konulan iskembe kabi icin uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Yiyecek veya yag koyma islevini korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: et veya yag konan iskembe kabi
bu kaba et parcalari koymak veya ona gore hazirlanmak

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal deri sepet veya iskembe kabi gibi tasima ve saklama kaplarini anlatir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komsu dal parcalari dikilerek yapilmis su tulumunu anlatir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Iki dal da deri veya organ kaynakli kap alanina yakindir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal toprak, et ya da yag icin kullanilan kaplara aittir; komsu dal dikilmis su tulumu gibi belirli bir su kabi adidir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Kap ve tasima komsulari coktur; yayinlanan ayrim ayni alan icindeki deri kap ile dikilmis su tulumu sinirini netlestirir.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الجبجبة بمعنى الزبيل من جلود ينقل فيه التراب، والكرش أو الوعاء الذي يجعل فيه اللحم أو الخلع أو الإهالة.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه الجبجبة إذا أريد بها مجرد الصوت على رأي المفردات، ولا ضخامة الجنبين.
branches.source_phrase_ar: الجبجبة زبيل من جلود يجمع فيه التراب والجبجبة الكرش يجعل فيه اللحم (maqayis)؛ الجبجبة الكرش يجعل فيها الخلع أو تذاب الإهالة فتحقن فيها والجبجبة أيضا زبيل من جلود ينقل فيه التراب (sihah)؛ الجبجبة زبيل من جلود ينقل فيه التراب والجبجبة الكرش يجعل فيها اللحم ويسمى الخلع (tahdhib)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesinin baskin bolumu insanlarin hurmayi asılamasini ve bunun zamanini verir. Bir kaynakta zamanin hasat zamaniyla yaklastirilmasi bulunsa da dal yalniz genel kesme anlamina indirgenemez; tanim hurma isleri baglamina bagli kalmalidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal hurma asilama isi ve mevsimiyle sinirlidir; genel kesme veya genel tarim zamani olarak genisletilmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Mekanik kapsam tamlama ve baglama baglidir; tanim hurma isini yalın kok anlamina cevirmeden verir.

concept_map.definition: Hurma agacini asılama isi ve bu isin yapildigi mevsim, kimi aktarimda hurma kesim zamaniyla iliskili zaman anlamidir.

facets.statement: Ana kullanim, insanlarin hurma agacini asılamasi eylemidir.
Ayni ad bu isin veya yakin hurma islerinin zamani icin kullanilir.
Bir aktarim zaman anlamini kesim zamaniyla yaklastirir, fakat dal hurma isleri baglaminda kalir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar hurma asilama eylemini ve bunun zamani olarak kullanimi birlikte verir. Zamanin hurma kesim donemine yaklastirildigi aktarim, cekirdegi genis bir kesme anlamina degil hurma islerinin mevsimine baglar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Hurma agaciyla ilgili bu ozel is ve onun mevsimi soz konusu oldugunda kullanilir.

error_profile.preserves: Asılama eylemini, zaman anlamini ve hurma baglamini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Insanlarin hurma agacina uyguladigi eylem anlatildiginda uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Hurma asilama eylemini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Zaman bildirimi olarak gecen kullanimlarda, asilama veya kesimle iliskili donemi aciklar.

error_profile.preserves: Zaman ve hurma isi baglamini korur.
error_profile.adds: Asilama ile kesim arasindaki kesin ayrimi gevsetir.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: hurma asilama veya hurma isleri zamani

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal hurma isine bagli asilama ve zaman adidir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komsu dal genel kokten kesip ayirma eylemidir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Ikisi bazi aktarimlarda kesim zamani imgesiyle temas eder.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal hurma agaci uzerindeki belirli tarim isine ve mevsime baglidir; komsu dal herhangi bir nesnenin kokunden kesilmesine aittir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Aday komsular hurma, bitki cikisi ve kesme alanindadir; yayinlanan ayrim kollokasyon sinirini korumak icindir.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه جب الناس النخل، وزمن الجباب، حيث فسرت المصادر الفعل بتلقيح النخل أو جعلته زمنا من أعمال النخل.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه أصل القطع العام إلا حيث ربطه المفردات بزمن الصرام.
branches.source_phrase_ar: وجب الناس النخل إذا ألقحوه وذا زمن الجباب (maqayis)؛ الجباب أيضا تلقيح النخل وقد جب الناس النخل (sihah)؛ إذا لقح الناس النخيل قيل قد جبوا وقد أتانا زمن الجباب (tahdhib)؛ كجب النخل وقيل زمن الجباب نحو زمن الصرام (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi yeryuzunun sert ve kalin yuzunu, sert topragi ve koparilan iri toprak kesegini verir. Kuyu anlami burada yalniz kazilabilecek zeminle temas eder, dalin kendisi kuyu degildir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal sert ve kalin toprak yuzeyidir; kuyu veya su cukuru anlamina kaydirilmaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Mekanik kapsam yalındır; tanim collocation baglamindan degil toprak yuzeyi adi olarak kurulur.

concept_map.definition: Yeryuzunun sert, kalin veya kaba toprakli yuzeyi ve bu yuzeyden koparilan iri toprak kesegi anlamidir.

facets.statement: Cekirdek anlam sert, kalin veya kaba yeryuzu tabakasidir.
Bu yuzeyden koparilan iri toprak kesegi de ayni alana baglanir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar sert veya kalin yeryuzu anlaminda ortaklasir; bazilari bunu dogrudan yuzey, bazilari kalin toprak olarak verir. Iri kesek aktarimi bu sert yuzeyden koparilan parcaya uzanir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Yeryuzunun kaba ve sert tabakasi ile ondan kopan iri kesek icin uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Sertlik, kalin toprak yuzeyi ve kesek uzantısını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Yeryuzunun sert tabakasi anlatildiginda uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Sert yuzey ve yeryuzu anlamini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Yerden koparilan kaba kesek anlaminda kullanilir.

error_profile.preserves: Koparilan iri kesek anlamini korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: yerden koparilan iri sert toprak kesegi

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal sert yer yuzeyi veya kesegidir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komsu dal su icin acilmis kaplanmamis kuyu adidir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Iki dal yeryuzu ve kazilmis ya da sert zemin alaninda temas eder.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal zeminin niteligini anlatir; komsu dal bu zeminde acilabilecek belirli bir su cukurunu adlandirir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Aday komsular sert zemin, yuzey ve kuyu alanlarindadir; yayinlanan ayrim sert zemin ile kuyu adini ayirir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi yolun ana caddesi ve toplandigi yer anlamini verir; birinin bu ana yola girmesi de ayni adla aktarilir. Sert toprak ya da kuyu anlamlariyla benzerlik alan degil, yalniz yolun belirli cizgisi uzerindedir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yolun ana ve islek hattiyla sinirlidir; zemin niteligi veya kuyu anlamina genisletilmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Mekanik kapsam yalındır; tanim yalin yol adi olarak verilir ve diger collocation anlamlari iceri alinmaz.

concept_map.definition: Yolun ana caddesi, gidisin toplandigi islek orta hatti ya da bu ana yol uzerinden gitme anlamidir.

facets.statement: Cekirdek anlam yolun ana, islek ve toplayici hattidir.
Bu ana hatta binmek veya onu izlemek de ayni kullanimda yer alir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar bu dali ana yol ve yolun toplandigi hat anlaminda verir. Bir aktarimda bu yola binme veya onu izleme ifadesi, adin pratik kullanimini gosterir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Yolun islek, acik ve gidisi toplayan ana cizgisi icin uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Ana yol, yolun toplayici hatti ve onu izleme kullanimini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Yolun genis ve temel gidis hatti anlatildiginda uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Ana yol anlamini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Birinin bu yol hattina girdigi veya onu izledigi baglamlarda kullanilir.

error_profile.preserves: Yolu izleme kullanimini korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: ana yol ve yolun toplanma hatti

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal yolun islek ana hattidir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komsu dal sert ve kalin yer yuzeyidir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Ikisi yeryuzu uzerindeki hat veya yuzey algisiyla temas eder.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Aday komsular yol ve yeryuzu alanlarina yogunlasir; yayinlanan ayrim ana yol ile sert zemin anlamini ayirir.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه المجبة بمعنى جادة الطريق ومجتمعه، أو ركوب المجبة أي الجادة.

branches.source_phrase_ar: المجبة جادة الطريق ومجتمعه (maqayis)؛ المجبة جادة الطريق (sihah)؛ ركب فلان المجبة وهي الجادة (tahdhib)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi kuyu, ozellikle kaplanmamis, derin, genis ya da kaya icinde acilmis su cukuru anlamini verir. Bu dal genel ic bosluk veya kap degil, belirli bir su kuyusu adidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal kaplanmamis veya derin kuyu anlamindadir; genel oyuk ve kap anlamlari ayridir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalin kuyu adi ve kuyu iciyle ilgili nitelemeler birlikte bulunur; tanim su kuyusu sinirini korur.

concept_map.definition: Kaplanmamis, derin, genis veya kaya icinde acilmis su kuyusu ve bu kuyunun ic yapisiyla ilgili kullanimlar anlamidir.

facets.statement: Cekirdek anlam, kaplanmamis veya derin su kuyusudur.
Kuyunun genis ic bolumu veya kaya icinde acilmis bicimi de ayni dalda yer alir.
Bir su yeri adi olarak kullanimi, kuyu anlamina bagli ozel addir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar kuyu anlamini ortak verir ve bunu kaplanmamislik, derinlik, su bollugu, genis ic veya kaya icinde acilmislik gibi ayrintilarla sinirlar. Bir yer-su adi olarak aktarim dalin cekirdegini degil ozel kullanimini gosterir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Kuyu, kaplanmamis kuyu, genis ya da kaya icindeki su cukuru anlamlarini karsilar.

error_profile.preserves: Kuyu, kaplanmamislik, derinlik ve genis ic ayrintilarini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Derin, bol sulu veya tabani uzak kuyu anlatildiginda uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Derin ve suyla ilgili kuyu anlamini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kuyunun ortasi veya ici genis olarak nitelenirse kullanilir.

error_profile.preserves: Kuyunun genis ic yapisini korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: genis icli kuyu veya kuyu ici

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal bagimsiz su kuyusudur.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komsu dal nesne icindeki giris yuvasi veya ic bolumdur.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Ikisi de ic bosluk ve giris alanina temas eder.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal yeryuzunde su icin acilmis kuyuya aittir; komsu dal mızrak ucu veya goz gibi bir nesnenin ic yuvasini anlatir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Komsular kuyu kazma, su cukuru ve ic bosluk alanlarindadir; yayinlanan ayrim su kuyusu ile nesne yuvasi arasindaki sinirdir.
